title: ForeignTensor, DLPack and provider-neutral descriptor
summary: ForeignTensor retains an independent provider/Python reference, exposes dtype/shape/byte-strides/device metadata, keeps DLPack capsules provider-internal, and offers native descriptor export with pin/release. NumPy/Torch zero-copy is explicitly qualified on CPU.
invariants: DLPack capsules never cross into ooRexx.
Torch element strides are normalized to bytes.
Closing the source proxy must not invalidate an independently retained ForeignTensor.
Generic CPU consumers must reject non-CPU device tensors.
